system.description: When you select this Talent, choose one Trained Skill. Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to that Skill, increase the die type of your Force Point by one step (i.e. from d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12), to a maximum of d12. You can select this Talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different Skill to gain the benefits of this Talent.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
